label: Sparse counts
main_interpretation: Sparse counts are the clearest latent-scale numerical-instability stress; stable replicates recover slopes but unstable replicates expose lambda-scale failure.

label: Low/heterogeneous exposure
stress_mechanism: Low and heterogeneous exposure; local information imbalance
main_interpretation: Low exposure mainly weakens low-exposure latent-risk recovery while regression slopes remain stable.

label: Strong overdispersion
main_interpretation: Strong overdispersion is manageable when counts remain abundant; r and kappa-level variability are recovered well.

label: Short time series
main_interpretation: Short T preserves slope recovery but weakens temporal-path recovery relative to T = 100 scenarios.

label: Spatial/covariate confounding
main_interpretation: Strong x2-phi confounding is successfully calibrated and remains stable in this high-count fixed-gamma setting.
